parameters.normalization: Collapse Unicode whitespace to one space; remove generated note markers, note headings and return labels. Punctuation, case and Unicode are retained. Identical note bodies share one destination.

transformations.operation: deduplicate identical notes and allocate unique reference IDs

parameters.metadata: title, language, identifier and fixed required modified timestamp only

checks.name: source conservation
checks.observation: All body and note text compared against parsed input under documented whitespace normalization; source-map.json

checks.name: forward and return links
checks.observation: Every reference checked structurally and clicked in the browser at every width/text setting; browser-audit.json

checks.name: damage detection
checks.observation: Broken forward, wrong return, lost body and lost note text rejected; negative-tests.json

uncertainties: No Kindle device, Kindle Previewer, native note popup or KDP acceptance test was available.
Browser reader is a custom iframe reader using extracted EPUB XHTML; it is not a Kindle emulator.
Case-page screenshots are offline local renders, not published GitHub or Pages captures.
human_steps: Original manuscript authored for this case.
Rendered reader and case-page screenshots reviewed after the run; review recorded separately in proof/visual-review.json.
